Components / Actions

Card action slot

.dr-card__actions · components/card.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Accept Decline
  1. 1.dr-card__actionsThe slot: a flex row, gap 8, no ground of its own, so the card's inset is unchanged.
  2. 2.dr-btn--primaryEach button in the slot takes flex:1, an equal share of the row, and z-index:2, so it stays tappable above a whole-card link.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: (.dr-card__actions).

States

No state of its own: the slot is a flex row with no ground. Its buttons take the button states.

When to use

The slot is where a card's own actions sit, so a card never lays out buttons ad hoc. It closes the card at its foot and holds one action or two on the same row and the same 8 gap. It stands on 7 cards on three screens: order-history (one card, View details), operator-listings (Accept · Decline on two offers, Continue on the job in progress) and wallet (three earning cards, View details). The buttons are links (<a>) on every one of them. The buttons in it are ordinary buttons; the slot adds only the row and the stacking above the card's link.

Labels follow the vocabulary: View details opens an order or a job, and client-side cards speak of an order, operator-side cards of a job.

Sources: inventory.md § 1 (Card action slot) · DESIGN.md § Cards · § The in-page group row (stacking order) · voice.md § Vocabulary

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Package delivery Today, 10:07 Earned₴180 View details

Actions at the foot of the card they belong to, inside .dr-card__actions, at the card's own inset. Copied from wallet.

Don’t

AcceptDeclineContact support

Three equal shares on a 341 card leave each label too little width, and Contact support is not this card's action. Keep the slot to one or two actions about the card itself; a screen-level action goes in the action bar, and a whole card that opens one destination is a card that is one link.
